articles.title: Man in Assam Bathes in Milk After Divorce to Symbolize Emotional Cleansing and Freedom
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Assam — In Nalbari district’s Baraliyapar village, a man named Manik Ali poured four buckets of milk over himself in public to mark his emotional “cleansing” and freedom after finalizing a divorce.

body.html:
Assam — In Nalbari district’s Baraliyapar village, a man named Manik Ali poured four buckets of milk over himself in public to mark his emotional “cleansing” and freedom after finalizing a divorce.

Manik said his wife repeatedly eloped with her lover despite his efforts to reconcile for their daughter’s sake. After she left again — this time taking their daughter — he opted for a mutual legal divorce.

To symbolize his fresh start, Manik declared, “From today, I am free… I was burdened. Now I’ve washed it all off,” while bathing in milk before cameras.

While some called it a publicity stunt, others saw it as an emotional act of closure.

articles.title: Goods Train Carrying Diesel Catches Fire After Derailment Near Thiruvallur; Rail Services Disrupted
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Goods Train Fire Near Thiruvallur, Tamil Nadu — July 13, 2025 A goods train carrying diesel from Chennai Port derailed near Thiruvallur early Sunday, causing four wagons to catch fire and spread to additional coaches.

body.html:
Goods Train Fire Near Thiruvallur, Tamil Nadu — July 13, 2025

A goods train carrying diesel from Chennai Port derailed near Thiruvallur early Sunday, causing four wagons to catch fire and spread to additional coaches. The blaze produced massive smoke and panic among residents, who were evacuated as a precaution.

Over 25 fire tenders and NDRF teams were deployed to control the fire, detach unaffected wagons, and secure the area. No injuries or fatalities have been reported.

The derailment disrupted suburban and express train services on the Chennai–Arakkonam line: 8 trains were cancelled, 5 diverted, and 8 short-terminated, affecting thousands of passengers.

The cause of the accident is under investigation. Restoration work is ongoing, and normal services will resume once the site is declared safe. Helplines have been set up to assist passengers.

articles.title: Agra FSDA Destroys 5,000 Litres of Adulterated Milk After Deaths of Two Children; Probe Underway
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Agra — The Food Safety and Drug Administration (FSDA) in Agra dumped 5,000 litres of adulterated milk worth ₹1.25 lakh after intercepting a suspicious milk tanker from Morena, Madhya Pradesh.

body.html:
Agra — The Food Safety and Drug Administration (FSDA) in Agra dumped 5,000 litres of adulterated milk worth ₹1.25 lakh after intercepting a suspicious milk tanker from Morena, Madhya Pradesh. The crackdown followed the suspicious deaths of two children who had consumed milk the previous night.

Acting on a tip-off, the FSDA found the tanker carrying “sapareta milk” — diluted with other substances — in violation of food safety norms and without temperature control. Samples were collected, and the dairy firm was penalised.

An investigation is underway to determine the cause of the children’s deaths and the extent of milk adulteration. The FSDA has vowed strict action against those responsible, highlighting the need for stronger enforcement of food safety standards in the region.

articles.title: Caught on Camera: IAS Officer Slaps Student Repeatedly in MP Exam Hall, Defends Action
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bhopal — A video of Bhind district magistrate Sanjeev Srivastava slapping a student multiple times during an exam in Madhya Pradesh has gone viral. The incident took place on April 1 during a BSc Mathematics exam at Deendayal Dangraulia Mahavidyalaya.

body.html:
Bhopal — A video of Bhind district magistrate Sanjeev Srivastava slapping a student multiple times during an exam in Madhya Pradesh has gone viral.

The incident took place on April 1 during a BSc Mathematics exam at Deendayal Dangraulia Mahavidyalaya. In the video, Srivastava drags student Rohit Rathore from his chair, slaps him repeatedly, and questions him about his exam paper. Rathore later claimed the assault injured his ear but said he felt powerless to protest because Srivastava is an IAS officer.

Srivastava defended his actions, citing an investigation into an organised cheating racket. He recommended the college, owned by a politician’s relative, be disqualified as an exam centre.

Srivastava has faced prior controversies, with the High Court questioning his conduct in another case and a local tehsildar accusing him and another officer of mental harassment in a complaint to the Chief Minister.

articles.title: Russian Woman Found Living With 2 Kids in Gokarna Cave With Expired Visa
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a startling discovery, a 40-year-old Russian woman was found living inside a cave with her two young daughters in the dense forests of Gokarna, Karnataka.

body.html:
In a startling discovery, a 40-year-old Russian woman was found living inside a cave with her two young daughters in the dense forests of Gokarna, Karnataka.

The woman, identified as Mohi, along with her daughters Priya (6) and Ama (4), was discovered on July 9 during a routine police patrol in the Ramteertha forest area, which had been recently affected by a minor landslide. Police noticed movement inside a cave and, upon inspection, found the family residing there.

Mohi reportedly arrived in India via Goa years ago and settled in Gokarna to live in seclusion for meditation. A small idol of Lord Rudra was also recovered from the cave, where she performed daily prayers. According to officials, she had been living amidst dangerous terrain, exposed to wild animals, snakes, and landslides, refusing to leave despite police requests.

Eventually, she agreed to move to an Ashram in Kumta after a prolonged persuasion. When police checked her documents, they discovered that her passport was misplaced, but later found it — revealing that her visa had expired back in 2017. After her visa expiry, she reportedly entered Nepal, and then re-entered India illegally via Goa before settling in Gokarna.

The matter has been escalated to the Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO) in Bengaluru. Arrangements are underway to deport her and her children back to Russia. Meanwhile, child welfare officials are ensuring the safety and well-being of the children during the legal proceedings.

Authorities are continuing to investigate how she managed to evade immigration checks and survive in the forest for years with two young children.

Agra (Uttar Pradesh) — A shocking case of domestic abuse has emerged from Agra, where Dr. Pradeep Baghel, previously jailed for murdering his first wife, has been accused of holding his second wife hostage and brutally assaulting her.

The woman, married to Dr. Baghel in 2015 and mother of a nine-year-old son, alleged that she was kept locked in a room, starved, and beaten mercilessly over trivial issues. Her brother rescued her after learning of her plight.

The victim informed police that she comes from a poor family and her husband is having an affair with another woman. She claimed that her in-laws — including her father-in-law Shiromani Singh, a former councillor — and brother-in-law supported her husband’s cruelty.

According to her statement, she endured years of violence and humiliation, with no food and constant beatings. Social media posts circulating the video of her ordeal have drawn widespread outrage.

The matter is under police investigation.

Police statement: "On the basis of the complaint received, a case has been registered by M.M. Gate Police Station and necessary legal action is being taken."

articles.title: Lahore Teacher Dies of Sudden Heart Attack During Lecture — Viral Video Sparks Vaccine Debate
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Lahore — In a tragic incident, a private school teacher in Lahore, Pakistan, died of a sudden heart attack while delivering a lecture during a teacher training session. The incident, captured on camera, has gone viral on social media, sparking shock, condolences, and debate.

body.html:
Lahore — In a tragic incident, a private school teacher in Lahore, Pakistan, died of a sudden heart attack while delivering a lecture during a teacher training session. The incident, captured on camera, has gone viral on social media, sparking shock, condolences, and debate.

The deceased, identified as Niaz Ahmed, was conducting a training session for fellow educators when he suddenly collapsed on the floor. Attendees rushed him to a nearby hospital, where doctors declared him dead on arrival.

In the viral video, Niaz can be seen speaking confidently with no signs of discomfort before suddenly falling to the ground, causing panic among the participants.

Social media users, colleagues, and students have paid tribute to Niaz Ahmed, remembered for his dedication as a middle-school Urdu teacher and his positive presence in the school community.

Meanwhile, the video has also ignited a heated debate online, with some users blaming Covid-19 vaccines for the rise in sudden heart attacks among young and middle-aged adults.

Experts, however, point out that heart disease is already on the rise globally due to a combination of factors — lifestyle changes, aging populations, and poor access to healthcare in low- and middle-income countries. Cardiovascular diseases remain a leading cause of death and disability worldwide.

articles.title: Korba Chaos: Drunken Brawl, Woman’s Meltdown Outside Club Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Korba (Chhattisgarh) — A high-voltage drunken brawl broke out between two rival groups outside One Night Club at Palm Mall in Transport Nagar late at night, drawing public attention after videos of the dramatic scene went viral on social media.

body.html:
Korba (Chhattisgarh) — A high-voltage drunken brawl broke out between two rival groups outside One Night Club at Palm Mall in Transport Nagar late at night, drawing public attention after videos of the dramatic scene went viral on social media.

The altercation, which began inside the pub under the jurisdiction of the CSEB outpost in TP Nagar, quickly spilled onto the street. Both groups engaged in heated arguments, aggressive behaviour, and damaged a Mahindra Thar vehicle during the clash.

Amid the ruckus, a visibly intoxicated woman created a major scene, referring to a man as her husband and accusing police of planning to kill him. In one of the viral videos, she is heard shouting, “Mere husband ko aap log maar ke gaad doge”, while a policeman, maintaining composure, asks her to leave.

Police arrived promptly and tried to pacify both sides, but neither group agreed to settle the matter. No formal complaint was lodged by either party at the time of reporting.
